siteProfile.sun_class_source: Effective sun = geometric × 1.00 clear-sky (Open-Meteo, estimate); grid 24.5 m, 919 cells; clear-sky fraction 1.00 = archive sunshine / radiation hours (Open-Meteo, estimate)
siteProfile.data_resolution_note: Soil data ≈250 m resolution, climate ≈km scale. Neighbourhood estimate, not a soil test.
